member.name: T:ErpBridge.Shared.AgentSettingsValidation
member.summary: Pure validation logic for the agent settings form. Lives in Shared (not in the WPF assembly) so the WPF view-model can be unit-tested from a headless net8.0 test project that does not load PresentationCore. The view-model is responsible for mirroring the form fields into this helper.
member.remarks:
Rules enforced:
SqlServer, SqlUserName, MikroDatabaseName — required, whitespace counts as missing.
CompanyNo, BranchNo — must parse as a non-negative 32-bit integer; the form passes them as text so we tolerate locale settings explicitly via .
The agent never validates the password here — empty passwords are legitimate for trusted-auth / Windows-integrated SQL connections and the adapter handles the resulting .

member.name: T:ErpBridge.Shared.ConnectionStringMasker
member.summary: Stateless helpers that scrub secrets out of SQL connection strings and arbitrary log lines. Used at every emit-to-log boundary so a stray LogInformation("...conn={Conn}...", conn) never leaks the SQL password to disk.
member.remarks: The masker intentionally does not throw on malformed input — it always returns the closest safe string. Empty / null inputs round-trip to the empty string so call sites can compose it freely.

member.name: T:ErpBridge.Shared.TrackedTableSchema
member.summary:
Immutable descriptor of one Mikro table that ErpBridge mirrors through the trigger-based change-tracking mechanism. The set of fields here is a strict superset of what the bootstrap reader needs — the three-way pull path uses only the subset supplied at call time so the wire payload stays small.
KeyField / KeyKind (Faz 15): the trigger installer and change reader use these to project a row's stable identifier into the _ERPB_SYNC.KayitKey shadow column. Most Mikro tables do not ship a Guid column, so the default fallback uses the with ; tables that do expose a Guid column can override via the constructor argument to take the faster Guid path.

SQL table name (e.g. STOKLAR, CARI_HESAPLAR).
Primary-key column for the row (e.g. sto_RECno). The trigger shadow row references the row by this column when is .
Full list of columns the adapter is allowed to read. Any other column requested by the caller is rejected to keep the SQL surface safe.
When true, the row is treated as deleted by the consumer when sto_iptal/cari_iptal/... equals 1; the trigger still fires for that update so the change propagates as a "changed" record.
Column whose value uniquely identifies a row across inserts and updates. Defaults to ; set to the table's *_Guid column when one exists.

member.name: M:ErpBridge.Shared.TrackedTableSchema.ComputeKeyValueExpression
member.summary:
Compute the SQL expression that produces the value written to the _ERPB_SYNC.KayitKey shadow column. The expression is safe to embed directly in a SELECT against the source table (the column is whitelisted through when the caller asks for the KeyValue field).
: the column is returned as-is (cast to NVARCHAR(64) by the trigger) so a value like 6F9619FF-... ends up in KayitKey.
: returns 'recno:' + CAST(T.<col> AS NVARCHAR(20)) so an int like 12345 ends up as recno:12345 in KayitKey.

member.name: T:ErpBridge.Shared.TrackedTableCatalog
member.summary:
Static catalogue of the 49 Mikro tables that ErpBridge watches through the _ERPB_SENKRONIZASYON trigger table. Table IDs match the reference app's TabloHelper.GetMikroV14DefaultTablolar() — keeping them aligned is mandatory for any downstream tooling that uses those IDs as opaque tokens.
The list is intentionally small enough to be read end-to-end and to make a "you changed table X" code review trivial. Soft-delete filter is enabled on master-data tables that carry a _*_iptal bit so the bootstrap reader can mirror the reference app's soft-delete convention.
